title: Release gate count drift: a capture merged behind the release branch stales the grounding block
observation: v1.26.2's first release run failed at the tagged gate: test/grounding-freshness asserted the committed CLAUDE.md decision count (219) against the public store (220). The release branch was cut from main, then PR #138 merged with a post-commit auto-captured decision, then the release PR merged on top; the grounding surfaces in the release commit predate that capture. Same class as the 2026-09-07/08 CI reds on the contract and site PRs. Nothing was published (publish skipped), so the fix was to regenerate grounding on main (1be6bef) and move the tag. Pattern: any merge that carries a `hunch: capture` commit after a release branch is cut will fail the gate unless grounding is regenerated on main immediately before tagging.
evidence: release run 34234886577: validate failure, publish skipped; log: 'decision count is the PUBLIC store's 219 !== 220' at test/grounding-freshness.test.ts:101
fix: 1be6bef chore(grounding): regenerate; tag v1.26.2 moved; run 34235896523
earlier instances: PR #128 (d3f1322) and PR #135 first CI reds, same test
